name: PR Claim Check
description: Lists what a PR description claims that the diff doesn't back up
about: Reads a pull request description against its own diff. buzzcut checks the names, files and test claims mechanically, then the bot goes through every sentence that says the change does something and finds the code that does it. You get a short list of claims to confirm, each with its evidence or the lack of it.
features: Check names, files and test claims with buzzcut
Match each behavior claim to the hunk that does it
Leave the verdict on each unbacked claim to you
examplePrompt: Check the description of the open PR on this branch. Which claims does the diff not back up?
